scripts.build: rm -rf build && diff src/external/cctv.worker.js src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js -u >src/external/cctv.worker.diff; npx tsc && mkdir build/external && cp src/external/cctv.worker.js build/external
scripts.bundle: rm -rf build/final && npx esbuild src/main.ts --sourcemap=linked --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=build/final/final.js && cd build/final && tar zcvf ../final.tar.gz . && zip -r ../final.zip .
scripts.bundle-web: rm -rf build/final-web && npx esbuild src/util.ts src/cmdutil.ts src/web-decrypt-worker.ts src/web-decrypt-worker-type.ts --sourcemap=linked --bundle --format=esm --outdir=build/final-web/ --external:./util.js --external:./cmdutil.js
scripts.sync-latest-worker: TMP=$(mktemp) && curl -qfsS https://player.cntv.cn/h5vod/cctv.worker.js | npx js-beautify -n >$TMP && if cmp "$TMP" src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js; then rm -f $TMP; else mv -f "$TMP" src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js && echo need to update cctv.worker.js; fi
